name: Charles River Campus
note: Places students visit outside class (libraries and dining with their own published hours). Each address comes from the BU page in source.pageUrl; a place inside an already-mapped building shares that building's OSM footprint, position and door, otherwise lat/lon is the area centroid of the OSM footprint at that address. Capacity is a configured size proxy (capacityNote), not a published seat count. No bbox: these sit inside the campus bbox.
